---
name: Capability or improvement
about: A production requirement, documentation gap or process improvement
title: ''
---

## Use case and affected layer

What does the consumer need? Is the capability an SDK primitive, a Kernel host
responsibility, or a harness feature?

## Current gap and evidence

Link relevant source, existing issues, roadmap items and reference patterns.
Do not assume that a feature in the harness exists in the SDK.

## Proposed scope and decisions

State the smallest useful change. Identify API, license-boundary, cost or strategy
decisions that need the owner. Separate required behavior from optional features.

## Acceptance criteria

Define runnable examples, contract tests and operational evidence needed to close
this issue. Define the supported scale before asking for load-test results.
